Planck.js 1.5.1, the Box2D-based JavaScript physics engine.

Source: https://github.com/piqnt/planck.js
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/planck/1.5.1
Documentation: https://piqnt.dev/planck.js/docs/

`planck.min.js` and `LICENSE.txt` are unchanged files from the official npm
package. The package SHA-512 integrity was verified before extracting these
files. Only the homepage loads this local build; no CDN is required.
